## import independent runs

```{r}
Validation_SD_3 <- read.csv("C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Screening Datasets/Validation/Validation_SD_3.csv")

# population type (p1/lwc)
Validation_P1_1 <- read.csv("C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Screening Datasets/Validation/Validation_P1_1.csv")

Validation_P1_2 <- read.csv("C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Screening Datasets/Validation/Validation_P1_2.csv")

Validation_P1_3 <- read.csv("C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Screening Datasets/Validation/Validation_P1_3.csv")

# sampling unit (p2/gi)
```

## clean and merge to form master sets
```{r}
# to lowercase column names and rename pred columns
Validation_SD_1 <- Validation_SD_1 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_sd = pred)

Validation_SD_2 <- Validation_SD_2 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_sd = pred)

Validation_SD_3 <- Validation_SD_3 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_sd = pred)

Validation_P1_1 <- Validation_P1_1 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_p1 = pred)

Validation_P1_2 <- Validation_P1_2 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_p1 = pred)

Validation_P1_3 <- Validation_P1_3 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_p1 = pred)

Validation_P2_1 <- Validation_P2_1 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_p2 = pred)

Validation_P2_2 <- Validation_P2_2 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_p2 = pred)

Validation_P2_3 <- Validation_P2_3 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_p2 = pred)

# merge them
# safety check
identical(Validation_SD_1$title , Validation_SD_2$title)
identical(Validation_SD_2$title , Validation_SD_3$title)

identical(Validation_P1_1$title , Validation_P1_2$title)
identical(Validation_P1_2$title , Validation_P1_3$title)

identical(Validation_P2_1$title , Validation_P2_2$title)
identical(Validation_P2_2$title , Validation_P2_3$title)

identical(Validation_SD_3$title , Validation_P1_1$title)

# merge
Validation_All_1 <- Validation_SD_1 %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = Validation_P1_1$pred_p1 ,
         pred_p2 = Validation_P2_1$pred_p2)

Validation_All_2 <- Validation_SD_2 %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = Validation_P1_2$pred_p1 ,
         pred_p2 = Validation_P2_2$pred_p2)

Validation_All_3 <- Validation_SD_3 %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = Validation_P1_3$pred_p1 ,
         pred_p2 = Validation_P2_3$pred_p2)

# more cleaning
# recode multiple classifications in p1 of runs 2 and 3 as "mixed"
Validation_All_1 <- Validation_All_1 %>%
  mutate(across(c(population_1_lwc, pred_p1) ,
                ~ case_when(str_detect(.x, ",")
                            ~"mixed",
                            TRUE ~ .x)))

Validation_All_2 <- Validation_All_2 %>%
  mutate(across(c(population_1_lwc, pred_p1) ,
                ~ case_when(str_detect(.x, ",")
                            ~"mixed",
                            TRUE ~ .x)))

Validation_All_3 <- Validation_All_3 %>%
  mutate(across(c(population_1_lwc, pred_p1) ,
                ~ case_when(str_detect(.x, ",")
                            ~"mixed",
                            TRUE ~ .x)))

# make all predictions lowercase
Validation_All_1 <- Validation_All_1 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2, str_to_lower))

Validation_All_2 <- Validation_All_2 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2, str_to_lower))

Validation_All_3 <- Validation_All_3 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2, str_to_lower))

# remove the word "animals" from the ends
Validation_All_1 <- Validation_All_1 %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = str_remove(pred_p1 , "animals$") %>%
         str_squish())

Validation_All_2 <- Validation_All_2 %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = str_remove(pred_p1 , "animals$") %>%
         str_squish())

Validation_All_3 <- Validation_All_3 %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = str_remove(pred_p1 , "animals$") %>%
         str_squish())

# remove the (?) from some values
Validation_All_1 <- Validation_All_1 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2 , ~ str_remove(.x , "\\s*\\(\\?\\)$")))

Validation_All_2 <- Validation_All_2 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2 , ~ str_remove(.x , "\\s*\\(\\?\\)$")))

Validation_All_3 <- Validation_All_3 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2 , ~ str_remove(.x , "\\s*\\(\\?\\)$")))

# add hyphens
Validation_All_1 <- Validation_All_1 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2 , ~ str_replace_all(.x , " " , "-")))

Validation_All_2 <- Validation_All_2 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2 , ~ str_replace_all(.x , " " , "-")))

Validation_All_3 <- Validation_All_3 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2 , ~ str_replace_all(.x , " " , "-")))

# remaining cleaning
# remove extra hyphens, convert empty values to NA
Validation_All_1 <- Validation_All_1 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2 , ~ str_remove(.x , "-+$")))

Validation_All_1 <- Validation_All_1 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2 , ~ na_if(.x , "")))

Validation_All_2 <- Validation_All_2 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2 , ~ str_remove(.x , "-+$")))

Validation_All_2 <- Validation_All_2 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2 , ~ na_if(.x , "")))

Validation_All_3 <- Validation_All_3 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2 , ~ str_remove(.x , "-+$")))

Validation_All_3 <- Validation_All_3 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:pred_p2 , ~ na_if(.x , "")))

# make human classifications lowercase and remove extra spacing
Validation_All_1 <- Validation_All_1 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:ob_2 , ~str_trim(str_to_lower(.x))))

Validation_All_2 <- Validation_All_2 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:ob_2 , ~str_trim(str_to_lower(.x))))

Validation_All_3 <- Validation_All_3 %>%
  mutate(across(jg_1:ob_2 , ~str_trim(str_to_lower(.x))))

```

```{r}
# study design

FullScreening_SD_3 <- read.csv("C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Screening Datasets/FullScreening/FullScreening_SD_3.csv")

# population type (p1/lwc)
FullScreening_P1 <- read.csv("C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Screening Datasets/FullScreening/FullScreening_P1.csv")

FullScreening_P1_2 <- read.csv("C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Screening Datasets/FullScreening/FullScreening_P1_2.csv")

FullScreening_P1_3 <- read.csv("C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Screening Datasets/FullScreening/FullScreening_P1_3.csv")

# sampling unit (p2/gi)
FullScreening_P2 <- read.csv("C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Screening Datasets/FullScreening/FullScreening_P2.csv")

FullScreening_P2_2 <- read.csv("C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Screening Datasets/FullScreening/FullScreening_P2_2.csv")

```

## clean and merge to form master sets
```{r}
# to lowercase column names and rename pred columns
FullScreening_SD <- FullScreening_SD %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower)

FullScreening_P1 <- FullScreening_P1 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower)

FullScreening_P2 <- FullScreening_P2 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower)

FullScreening_SD_2 <- FullScreening_SD_2 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_sd = pred)

FullScreening_P1_2 <- FullScreening_P1_2 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_p1 = pred)

FullScreening_P2_2 <- FullScreening_P2_2 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_p2 = pred)

FullScreening_SD_3 <- FullScreening_SD_3 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_sd = pred)

FullScreening_P1_3 <- FullScreening_P1_3 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_p1 = pred)

FullScreening_P2_3 <- FullScreening_P2_3 %>%
  rename_with(str_to_lower) %>%
  rename(pred_p2 = pred)

# recode predictions with multiple groups into 'multiple' option
FullScreening_P1 <- FullScreening_P1 %>%
  mutate(pred = case_when(
    str_detect(pred, ",")
    ~"mixed",
    TRUE ~ pred
  ))

## merge into FullScreening_All
# make sure the studies line up
identical(FullScreening_SD$title, FullScreening_P1$title)
identical(FullScreening_SD$title, FullScreening_P2$title)

# add prediction columns from P1 and P2 to SD, and rename pred columns
FullScreening_All <- FullScreening_SD %>%
  rename(pred_sd = pred) %>%
  mutate(
    pred_p1 = FullScreening_P1$pred,
    pred_p2 = FullScreening_P2$pred
  )

# make all predictions lowercase
FullScreening_All <- FullScreening_All %>%
  mutate(across(pred_sd:pred_p2, str_to_lower))

# make all column names lowercase
FullScreening_All <- FullScreening_All %>%
  rename_with(tolower)

# remove the word "animals" from the ends
FullScreening_All <- FullScreening_All %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = str_remove(pred_p1 , "animals$") %>%
         str_squish())

# merge into FullScreening_All_2 and FullScreening_All_3
# safety check
identical(FullScreening_P1$title , FullScreening_P1_2$title)
identical(FullScreening_P1_2$title , FullScreening_P1_3$title)

identical(FullScreening_P2$title , FullScreening_P2_2$title)
identical(FullScreening_P2_2$title , FullScreening_P2_3$title)

identical(FullScreening_SD$title , FullScreening_SD_2$title)
identical(FullScreening_SD_2$title , FullScreening_SD_3$title)

identical(FullScreening_SD_3$title , FullScreening_P1$title)

# merge
FullScreening_All_2 <- FullScreening_SD_2 %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = FullScreening_P1_2$pred_p1 ,
         pred_p2 = FullScreening_P2_2$pred_p2)

FullScreening_All_3 <- FullScreening_SD_3 %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = FullScreening_P1_3$pred_p1 ,
         pred_p2 = FullScreening_P2_3$pred_p2)

# recode multiple classifications in p1 of runs 2 and 3 as "mixed"
FullScreening_All_2 <- FullScreening_All_2 %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = case_when(
    str_detect(pred_p1, ",")
    ~"mixed",
    TRUE ~ pred_p1
  ))

FullScreening_All_3 <- FullScreening_All_3 %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = case_when(
    str_detect(pred_p1, ",")
    ~"mixed",
    TRUE ~ pred_p1
  ))

# make all predictions lowercase
FullScreening_All_2 <- FullScreening_All_2 %>%
  mutate(across(pred_sd:pred_p2, str_to_lower))

FullScreening_All_3 <- FullScreening_All_3 %>%
  mutate(across(pred_sd:pred_p2, str_to_lower))

# remove the word "animals" from the ends
FullScreening_All_2 <- FullScreening_All_2 %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = str_remove(pred_p1 , "animals$") %>%
         str_squish())

FullScreening_All_3 <- FullScreening_All_3 %>%
  mutate(pred_p1 = str_remove(pred_p1 , "animals$") %>%
         str_squish())

```


# ALLUVIAL PLOT (FIGURE X)
## library
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggalluvial)
library(ggh4x)

```

## make the plot
```{r}
# data for the plot
alluvial_by_design <- FullScreening_All %>%
  count(pred_sd , pred_p1 , pred_p2 , name = "n") %>%
  mutate(pred_sd = factor(pred_sd , levels = c(
    "cross-sectional" ,
    "cohort" ,
    "case-control" ,
    "unknown")) ,
    pred_p1 = factor(pred_p1 , levels = c(
      "livestock" ,
      "companion" ,
      "captive" ,
      "wild" ,
      "mixed" ,
      "unknown")) ,
    pred_p2 = factor(pred_p2 , levels = c(
      "individual" ,
      "group" ,
      "unknown")))

# create the plot
alluvial_by_design_plot <- ggplot(alluvial_by_design , aes(
  axis1 = pred_p1 ,
  axis2 = pred_p2 ,
  y = n)) +
  geom_flow(aes(fill = pred_p1) ,
            width = 0.25 ,
            alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_stratum(width = 0.25 ,
               fill = "white" ,
               color = "grey" ,
               linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum" ,
            aes(label = str_to_sentence(after_stat(stratum))) ,
            size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("livestock" = "#c98276" ,
                               "companion" = "#c18a35" ,
                               "captive" = "#6b8e23" ,
                               "wild" = "#5b8fb9" ,
                               "mixed" = "#9a72ac" ,
                               "unknown" = "#5b837d") ,
                    labels = str_to_sentence) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c(
    "Population type" ,
    "Sampling unit") ,
    expand = c(0.1 , 0.1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ pred_sd ,
             ncol = 2 ,
             scales = "free_y" ,
             labeller = labeller(pred_sd = c("cross-sectional" = "a) Cross-sectional" ,
                                             "cohort" = "b) Cohort" ,
                                             "case-control" = "c) Case-control" ,
                                             "unknown" = "d) Unknown"))) +
  facetted_pos_scales(y = list(pred_sd == "cross-sectional" ~ scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0 , 3000 , 1000)) ,
                               pred_sd == "cohort" ~ scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0 , 750 , 250)) ,
                               pred_sd == "case-control" ~ scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0 , 75 , 25)) ,
                               pred_sd == "unknown" ~ scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0 , 4000 , 1000)))) +
  labs(x = NULL ,
       y = "Number of studies" ,
       fill = "Population type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank() ,
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank() ,
        strip.text = element_text(
          face = "bold" ,
          size = 11) ,
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          face = "bold" ,
          size = 8) ,
        legend.position = "bottom" ,
        panel.spacing = unit(1.5 , "cm"))

alluvial_by_design_plot

# save for better dimensions
ggsave(
  "alluvial_FINAL.png" ,
  path = "C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Tables and Figures" ,
  plot = alluvial_by_design_plot ,
  width = 10 ,
  height = 9 ,
  units = "in" ,
  dpi = 300)

```


# COUNTS TABLE HUMAN/LLM IN VALIDATION SET FOR STUDY DESIGN (TABLE Xa)
## library
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)

```

## make the table
```{r}
# agreement counts
agreement_sd <- Validation_All_1 %>%
  group_by(consensus) %>%
  summarise(human_n = n() , agreement_n = sum(consensus == pred_sd , na.rm = TRUE) ,
            agreement_percent = agreement_n / human_n * 100 , .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Agreement = paste0(agreement_n , " (" , round(agreement_percent , 1) , "%)")) %>%
  select(consensus, Agreement) %>%
  rename(`Study design` = consensus)

# counts and percentages table
validation_counts_table_sd315 <- bind_rows(
  Validation_All_1 %>%
    count(consensus , name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100 ,
           source = "Human") %>%
    rename(`Study design` = consensus) ,
  Validation_All_1 %>%
    count(pred_sd , name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100 ,
           source = "LLM") %>%
    rename(`Study design` = pred_sd) ,
  FullScreening_All %>%
    count(pred_sd , name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100 , source = "Screening") %>%
    rename(`Study design` = pred_sd)) %>%
  mutate(value = paste0(n , " (" ,  round(percent , 1) , "%)")) %>%
  select(`Study design` , source , value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source , values_from = value) %>%
  left_join(agreement_sd , by = "Study design") %>%
  select(`Study design` , Human , LLM , Agreement , Screening)


validation_counts_table_sd315

# define n = 
n_validationset315 <- nrow(Validation_All_1)
n_fullscreeningall <- nrow(FullScreening_All)

# format it into publishable style
validation_counts_table_sd315_3 <- validation_counts_table_sd315 %>%
  mutate(`Study design` = str_to_sentence(`Study design`)) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  add_header_row(values = c("" , paste0("Validation Set\n(n = " , n_validationset315 , ")") , paste0("Screening Set\n(n = " , n_fullscreeningall , ")")) ,
                 colwidths = c(1 , 3 , 1) ,
                 top = TRUE) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(j = 1 , align = "left" , part = "all") %>%
  align(j = 2:5 , align = "center" , part = "all") %>%
  autofit()

validation_counts_table_sd315_3

save_as_docx(validation_counts_table_sd315_3 , path = "C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Tables and Figures/validation_counts_table_sd_FINAL.docx")
save_as_image(validation_counts_table_sd315_3 , path = "C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Tables and Figures/validation_counts_table_sd_FINAL.png")

```


# COUNTS TABLE HUMAN/LLM IN VALIDATION SET FOR P1 and P2 (TABLE Xb)
## library
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)

```

## make the table
```{r}
# subset of population
Validation_Pop_1 <- Validation_All_1 %>%
  filter(consensus != "unknown")

# population type (p1) section
# agreement counts
agreement_p1 <- Validation_Pop_1 %>%
  group_by(population_1_lwc) %>%
  summarise(human_n = n() , agreement_n = sum(population_1_lwc == pred_p1) ,
            agreement_percent = agreement_n / human_n * 100 , .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Agreement = paste0(agreement_n , " (" , round(agreement_percent , 1) , "%)")) %>%
  select(population_1_lwc, Agreement) %>%
  rename(Category = population_1_lwc)

# p1 counts
table_p1 <- bind_rows(
  Validation_Pop_1 %>%
    count(population_1_lwc , name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100 , source = "Human") %>%
    rename(Category = population_1_lwc) ,
  Validation_Pop_1 %>%
    count(pred_p1 , name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100 , source = "LLM") %>%
    rename(Category = pred_p1) ,
  FullScreening_All %>%
    filter(pred_sd != "unknown") %>%
    count(pred_p1 , name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100 , source = "Screening") %>%
    rename(Category = pred_p1)) %>%
  mutate(value = paste0(n , " (" , round(percent , 1) , "%)")) %>%
  select(Category , source , value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source , values_from = value) %>%
  left_join(agreement_p1 , by = "Category") %>%
  select(Category , Human , LLM , Agreement , Screening)

# sampling unit (p2) section
# agreement counts
agreement_p2 <- Validation_Pop_1 %>%
  group_by(population_2_gi) %>%
  summarise(human_n = n() , agreement_n = sum(population_2_gi == pred_p2) ,
            agreement_percent = agreement_n / human_n * 100 , .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Agreement = paste0(agreement_n , " (" , round(agreement_percent , 1) , "%)")) %>%
  select(population_2_gi, Agreement) %>%
  rename(Category = population_2_gi)

# p2 counts
table_p2 <- bind_rows(
  Validation_Pop_1 %>%
    count(population_2_gi , name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100 , source = "Human") %>%
    rename(Category = population_2_gi) ,
  Validation_Pop_1 %>%
    count(pred_p2 , name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100 , source = "LLM") %>%
    rename(Category = pred_p2) ,
  FullScreening_All %>%
    filter(pred_sd != "unknown") %>%
    count(pred_p2 , name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100 , source = "Screening") %>%
    rename(Category = pred_p2)) %>%
  mutate(value = paste0(n , " (" , round(percent , 1) , "%)")) %>%
  select(Category , source , value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source , values_from = value) %>%
  left_join(agreement_p2 , by = "Category") %>%
  select(Category , Human , LLM , Agreement , Screening)


# combine p1 and p2 tables into one
validation_counts_table_p1p2315 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Category = "Population type" ,
         Human = NA_character_ ,
         LLM = NA_character_ ,
         Agreement = NA_character_ ,
         Screening = NA_character_) ,
  table_p1 ,
  tibble(Category = "Sampling unit" ,
         Human = NA_character_ ,
         LLM = NA_character_ ,
         Agreement = NA_character_ ,
         Screening = NA_character_) ,
  table_p2) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Human , LLM , Agreement , Screening) ,
                ~ if_else(Category == "unknown" & is.na(.x) , "N/A" , .x)))


# define n =
n_validation_pop <- nrow(Validation_Pop_1)

n_screening_pop <- FullScreening_All %>%
  filter(pred_sd != "unknown") %>%
  nrow()

section_rows <- which(
  validation_counts_table_p1p2315$Category %in% c("Population type" , "Sampling unit"))


# format into publishable style
validation_counts_table_p1p2315_2 <- validation_counts_table_p1p2315 %>%
  mutate(Category = str_to_sentence(Category)) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("" , paste0("Validation Set\n(n = " , n_validation_pop , ")") ,
               paste0("Screening Set\n(n = " , n_screening_pop , ")")) ,
    colwidths = c(1 , 3 , 1) , top = TRUE) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(j = 1 , align = "left" , part = "all") %>%
  align(j = 2:5 , align = "center" , part = "all") %>%
  autofit()

# merge section-heading rows across columns
```

# PERFORMANCE METRICS ACROSS THREE RUNS IN VALIDATION SET (SUPPLEMENTARY TABLE X)
## library
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(yardstick)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

```

## function for metrics on one run
```{r}
calculate_validation_metrics <- function(data , truth_col , pred_col , characteristic_name) {
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[truth_col]]))
  
  n_validation <- nrow(analysis_data)
  
  truth <- analysis_data[[truth_col]]
  estimate <- analysis_data[[pred_col]]
  
  classes <- unique(truth)
  
  levels_all <- union(unique(truth) , unique(estimate))
  
  truth_factor <- factor(truth , levels = levels_all)
  
  estimate_factor <- factor(estimate , levels = levels_all)
  
  # overall metrics
  overall <- tibble(Characteristic = characteristic_name , n = n_validation , Class = "Overall" , Metric = c("Cohen's kappa" , "Accuracy") ,
                    Value = c(kap_vec(truth = truth_factor , estimate = estimate_factor , weighting = "none") ,
                              accuracy_vec(truth = truth_factor , estimate = estimate_factor)))
  
  # class-specific metrics
  class_metrics <- map_dfr(classes , function(cls) {
    
    truth_binary <- factor(if_else(truth == cls, "yes" , "no") , levels = c("yes" , "no"))
    
    estimate_binary <- factor(if_else(estimate == cls, "yes" , "no") , levels = c("yes" , "no"))
    
    tibble(Characteristic = characteristic_name , n = n_validation , Class = cls , Metric = c("Sensitivity" , "Specificity") ,
           Value = c(sens_vec(truth = truth_binary , estimate = estimate_binary , event_level = "first") ,
                     spec_vec(truth = truth_binary , estimate = estimate_binary , event_level = "first")))
  })
  
  bind_rows(overall , class_metrics)
}


# function for all metrics on one run

calculate_one_run <- function(data , run_name) {
  bind_rows(calculate_validation_metrics(data = data , truth_col = "consensus" , pred_col = "pred_sd" , characteristic_name = "Study design") ,
            calculate_validation_metrics(data = data , truth_col = "population_1_lwc" , pred_col = "pred_p1" , characteristic_name = "Population type") ,
            calculate_validation_metrics(data = data , truth_col = "population_2_gi" , pred_col = "pred_p2" , characteristic_name = "Sampling unit")) %>%
    mutate(Run = run_name)
}

```

# VALIDATION RESULTS FOR MAIN THESIS BODY (TABLES X AND Y)
## library
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(yardstick)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

```

## calculate performance metrics
```{r}
set.seed(1234)

# first calculate human kappa
human_kappa_sd <- Validation_All_1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(jg_1) , !is.na(ob_1)) %>%
  mutate(jg_1 = factor(jg_1) , ob_1 = factor(ob_1 , levels = levels(jg_1))) %>%
  summarise(kappa = kap_vec(truth = jg_1 , estimate = ob_1 , weighting = "none")) %>%
  pull(kappa)

human_kappa_sd

# function for CIs
# for proportion metrics use Wilson CI
wilson_ci <- function(successes , total , conf_level = 0.95) {
  ci <- prop.test(x = successes , n = total , conf.level = conf_level , correct = FALSE)$conf.int
  c(lower = ci[1] , upper = ci[2])
}

# for kappa use bootstrap CI
bootstrap_kappa_ci <- function(truth_factor , estimate_factor , weighting = "none" , R = 2000) {
  boot_estimates <- replicate(R , {index <- sample(seq_along(truth_factor) , size = length(truth_factor) ,
                                                   replace = TRUE)
  kap_vec(truth = truth_factor[index] , estimate = estimate_factor[index] , weighting = weighting)})
  ci <- quantile(boot_estimates , probs = c(0.025 , 0.975) , na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(lower = as.numeric(ci[1]) , upper = as.numeric(ci[2]))
}

format_estimate_ci <- function(estimate , lower , upper) {
  sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)" , estimate , lower , upper)
}


# human kappa
human_sd_boot_data <- Validation_All_1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(jg_1) , !is.na(ob_1)) %>%
  mutate(jg_1 = factor(jg_1) , ob_1 = factor(ob_1 , levels = levels(jg_1)))

human_kappa_ci <- bootstrap_kappa_ci(truth_factor = human_sd_boot_data$jg_1 , estimate_factor = human_sd_boot_data$ob_1 , weighting = "none" , R = 2000)

human_kappa_results <- tibble(Characteristic = "Study design" , human_kappa = as.numeric(human_kappa_sd) ,
                              human_kappa_lower = as.numeric(human_kappa_ci$lower) , human_kappa_upper = as.numeric(human_kappa_ci$upper))

# LLM overall performance
calculate_overall_ci <- function(data , truth_col , pred_col , characteristic_name) {
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[truth_col]]))
  truth <- analysis_data[[truth_col]]
  estimate <- analysis_data[[pred_col]]
  n_validation <- length(truth)
  
  levels_all <- union(unique(truth) , unique(estimate))
  truth_factor <- factor(truth , levels = levels_all)
  estimate_factor <- factor(estimate , levels = levels_all)
  kappa_ci <- bootstrap_kappa_ci(truth_factor = truth_factor , estimate_factor = estimate_factor , weighting = "none" , R = 2000)
  
# accuracy CI
  correct <- sum(truth == estimate , na.rm = TRUE)
  accuracy_ci <- wilson_ci(successes = correct , total = n_validation)
  tibble(Characteristic = characteristic_name ,
         kappa_lower = kappa_ci$lower , kappa_upper = kappa_ci$upper ,
         accuracy_lower = accuracy_ci["lower"] , accuracy_upper = accuracy_ci["upper"])
}

# overall CI
overall_ci <- bind_rows(calculate_overall_ci(Validation_All_1 , "consensus" , "pred_sd", "Study design") ,
                        calculate_overall_ci(Validation_All_1 , "population_1_lwc" , "pred_p1" , "Population type") ,
                        calculate_overall_ci(Validation_All_1 , "population_2_gi" , "pred_p2" , "Sampling unit"))

```

```{r}
         `LLM Κ (95% CI)` = format_estimate_ci(llm_kappa , kappa_lower , kappa_upper) ,
```

## class-specific classification performance (table y)
```{r}
# function for class-specific CI
calculate_class_ci <- function(data , truth_col , pred_col , characteristic_name) {
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[truth_col]]))
  truth <- analysis_data[[truth_col]]
  estimate <- analysis_data[[pred_col]]
  classes <- unique(truth)
  map_dfr(classes , function(cls) {
    class_n <- sum(truth == cls , na.rm = TRUE)
    true_positive <- sum(truth == cls & estimate == cls , na.rm = TRUE)
    sensitivity_ci <- wilson_ci(successes = true_positive , total = class_n)
    negative_n <- sum(truth != cls , na.rm = TRUE)
    true_negative <- sum(truth != cls & estimate != cls , na.rm = TRUE)
    specificity_ci <- wilson_ci(successes = true_negative , total = negative_n)
    
    tibble(Characteristic = characteristic_name , Class = cls , class_n = class_n , sensitivity_lower = sensitivity_ci["lower"] , sensitivity_upper = sensitivity_ci["upper"] ,
           specificity_lower = specificity_ci["lower"] , specificity_upper = specificity_ci["upper"])
  })
}

class_ci <- bind_rows(calculate_class_ci(Validation_All_1 , "consensus" , "pred_sd" , "Study design") ,
                      calculate_class_ci(Validation_All_1 , "population_1_lwc" , "pred_p1" , "Population type") ,
                      calculate_class_ci(Validation_All_1 , "population_2_gi" , "pred_p2" , "Sampling unit"))

# make the table
table_class_validation <- validation_metrics_all_runs %>%
  filter(Run == "Run 1" , Class != "Overall" , Metric %in% c("Sensitivity" , "Specificity")) %>%
  select(Characteristic , Class , Metric , Value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Metric , values_from = Value) %>%
  left_join(class_ci , by = c("Characteristic" , "Class")) %>%
  mutate(`Sensitivity (95% CI)` = format_estimate_ci(Sensitivity , sensitivity_lower , sensitivity_upper) ,
         `Specificity (95% CI)` = format_estimate_ci(Specificity , specificity_lower , specificity_upper)) %>%
  select(Characteristic , Class , n = class_n , `Sensitivity (95% CI)` , `Specificity (95% CI)`) %>%
  arrange(factor(Characteristic , levels = c("Study design" , "Population type" , "Sampling unit")))

# separator lines
separator_rows <- which(table_class_validation$Characteristic != lag(table_class_validation$Characteristic))

separator_rows <- separator_rows[!is.na(separator_rows)]

# make it publishable
table_class_validation_flex_ci <- table_class_validation %>%
  mutate(Class = str_to_sentence(Class)) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  merge_v(j = "Characteristic") %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  bold(j = "Characteristic" , part = "body") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(j = c("Characteristic" , "Class") , align = "left" , part = "all") %>%
  align(j = c("n" , "Sensitivity (95% CI)" , "Specificity (95% CI)") , align = "center" , part = "all") %>%
  font(fontname = "Arial" , part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10 , part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding = 4 , part = "all") %>%
  border(i = separator_rows , border.top = fp_border(width = 1)) %>%
  autofit()

table_class_validation_flex_ci

save_as_docx(table_class_validation_flex_ci , path = "C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Tables and Figures/table_class_validation_FINAL.docx")
save_as_image(table_class_validation_flex_ci , path = "C:/Users/jacob/OneDrive/Desktop/Tables and Figures/table_class_validation_FINAL.png")

```

```{r}
                                     FullScreening_All_2 %>%

                                       select(Characteristic , Class , Run , n , percent) ,

                                       count(pred_p1 , name = "n") %>%
                                       mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100 , Characteristic = "Population type" , Class = pred_p1 , Run = "Run 2") %>%
                                       select(Characteristic , Class , Run , n , percent) ,
                                     FullScreening_All_2 %>%
                                       count(pred_p2 , name = "n") %>%
                                       mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100 , Characteristic = "Sampling unit" , Class = pred_p2 , Run = "Run 2") %>%
                                       select(Characteristic , Class , Run , n , percent) ,
```
